title: augustine's EDNA
description: The Perfected Vanilla client side modpack | works on low end PCs!
body:
# EDNA - Enhanced Dynamics and New Additions

Now included with every QoL mod you need for an authentic quote unquote "vanilla" survival experience. Scroll down for a complete mod list. 

Every release comes with two versions - WASD and ESDF keybinds for an easy plug and play experience


## Here's an overview:
ReShaded for Core Shaders without FPS loss

![comparison of ReShaded](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a360432ae028c8e53671fcf2b23dfd4117e80352.jpeg)

Xali's plants grow in water

![xali's plants generate in water](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed27e36b63fbfc02b62a87ae6a33330e214b6b7f_0.webp)

Connected paths with texturized haybales

![connected paths with texturized haybales](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb89ab37db81170e2b9081c9a0d9425c56902045.png)

Cubic Sun and Moon

3D crops

Animated mobs and players 

Glowing Ores

Colorful containers


## QOL mods included:

-Xaero's Minimap
-Chat Heads
-Freecam
-Inventory Sort (only mod requiring server support) (can join servers without it)
-Lamb Dynamic Lights (hold a torch and light your way)
-Litematica for schematics
-Packed Lists for easy resource pack handling
-Scroll Tweaks
-Zoomify for zoom
-ReShaded by DR7 for Core Shader support
-Boat item view
-Explosive Enhancements
-Mod Menu
-Notes

## Resource Packs:

-Cubic Sun and Moon
-3d crops
